findings.body: The doc comment tells users that valid values are `off`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, yet the field is a plain `String`. An invalid value will not be caught at parse time and will either be silently forwarded to the model (acting differently than documented) or produce a runtime error that could have been prevented. Following the repository's own practice of using PascalCase types for meaningful enums, this should be a proper enum. Define a small enum for the four variants and implement `Deserialize` (or use `serde_repr` / `strum`). This also ensures the `off`-rescues-empty-content semantic is preserved and communicated in the type system.
findings.title: Use an enum instead of String for `reasoning_effort`

value.summary: Adds a `reasoning_effort` field with a string type, but the repository's config types presumably use enums or well-known string constants; the field is unvalidated and the doc comment describes valid values without enforcing them at the type level.
